access.notes: Clay offers free and self-serve plans (Free, Launch, Growth) with actions and data credits, but advanced features like Clay API access and table queries are restricted to Enterprise plans.

api_surface.notes: Webhook automation is mentioned as part of Growth plans and the platform provides a Clay CLI and API access.
